title:
18.09.24 - Watergrove reservoir 💦 

Walking and Sunshine support session ☀️ 

Walking provides the best of both worlds. It offers the physical benefits of exercise while also boosting your emotional well-being. 🏃🏼‍♀️ 

You can walk anywhere without equipment or a special membership. The more you do it, the more positive effects you’ll experience.

Watergrove is high in the Pennines above Wardle village, the area around Watergrove Reservoir includes walking trails with spectacular views, bird watching, fishing and a link to the Pennine Bridleway.

#bluepitshousingaction #walking
